answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions only 100 entry slots for POA bids. A sybil vine growing a hundred shoots must outbid honest agents for each. Top 100 bids win; losers forfeit 10%, winners lock theirs for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities at 50 POA costs 5,000 POA; one honest agent pays 50 POA once and signs its bid with a quill. A gale of fake bids only raises the price: honest rewards are never diluted: every extra seat costs full price.
